title: Announcing Cloudflare Wallets: The programmable wallet for the agentic Internet
excerpt: Cloudflare Wallets will provide AI agents with native payments and verifiable identity on the web. Using the x402 protocol, agents can autonomously purchase APIs and content within clear safety guardrails.
content_html:
Today, it is difficult for AI agents to try out new APIs. They often have to navigate through a login page designed for humans and not agents, contact a human to add a payment method, generate an API key, and then figure out how to call the API.

This flow is very difficult for agents for two reasons: Agents do not have a stable identifier to sign up for an API, and they do not have a native way to pay for APIs. Because they lack these things, they often struggle to onboard onto software, which limits the growth of agentic commerce. AI agents often give up on these tasks entirely, kicking registration, payment methods, and API key generation back to humans. This makes it very difficult for agents to try out and compare many APIs.

To solve this, we’ve created Cloudflare Wallets. Starting today, you can claim a Cloudflare Wallet handle for your account, which will provide a unique username to help you better connect with merchants. Soon, you will be able to set up and use your Cloudflare Wallet to pay for APIs and content.

Earlier this month, we announced the Monetization Gateway to help Cloudflare customers get paid for their websites and applications. Monetization Gateway will support micropayments using the x402 protocol, which allows for payments to be attached to HTTP requests. These micropayments will be able to pay for uses ranging from AI inference to data to content. If you want to pay or get paid for services behind Monetization Gateway and other x402-compatible endpoints, you’ll need a wallet. 

Cloudflare Wallets will allow you to store stablecoins, purchase services, and receive funds across the web. Each account with a wallet will also be able to create Virtual Wallets for its agents to enable them to buy APIs, MCP Tools, content, and more. You will be able to define guardrails for your Virtual Wallets (such as an allowance, an allow list, and a maximum transaction size) to help your agent spend money safely from your account. This will allow your agent to try out many APIs with low friction and managed risk. Wallet users will have the option to share their Cloudflare Wallet handles, which will give them a stable identity when interacting with merchants.

Building the two-sided agentic market

Cloudflare’s Monetization Gateway will allow eligible Cloudflare customers to sell their resources (such as content or APIs) headlessly to agentic buyers. But for that market to truly develop, agents need more tools to buy from merchants in a machine-native way. Wallets will add another tool to Cloudflare’s Agents SDK, enabling AI agents to easily purchase necessary APIs and content using micropayments.

There will be two types of Cloudflare Wallets: Account Wallets and Virtual Wallets.

Account Wallets are designed for humans who are owners and users of Cloudflare accounts. They will be able to add funds, delegate spend to virtual wallets managed by agents, and remove funds as needed. 

Virtual Wallets, by contrast, are designed for agents and operate via API keys. Within a Virtual Wallet, an agent will be able to spend funds according to its permissions. Its maximum spend will be capped by the limit set by the owner of the Account Wallet. This framework gives agents freedom to act on behalf of users without constant manual approval while limiting an agent’s ability to overspend.

The freedom to explore

Virtual Wallets are exciting because they will allow agents to do what they’re best at: explore dozens or hundreds of services and find the best one for a particular use case. Stablecoin micropayments via x402 will make it simple to try an API without an account, allowing agents to test new options with little friction. The spending caps on Virtual Wallets are designed so that humans can let agents explore autonomously within safe spending limits. These limits may seem like constraints, but counterintuitively they give agents more freedom. If an agent is responsible for $10, you can worry less about its spending than if it is responsible for $1,000. If an API only costs a few cents to try, then $10 is more than sufficient to pursue and evaluate many options.

Once you or your agent has picked an API to use, policies set by you in your Account Wallet will act as cost controls for Virtual Wallets. Want to give every employee a $100 per week budget for AI inference? Simply provision an Account Wallet with the right balance and create Virtual Wallets for each employee with that rule. Anyone who exceeds the limits on their Virtual Wallet will be able to request a manual override from a human who is authorized to make changes to the Account Wallet.

We want to make it easy for Account Wallets to set flexible yet firm spending policies that do not require daily, active monitoring. When something anomalous happens, such as unexpectedly fast spending, a human will be able to review and confirm whether everything is operating as intended. If the spend was intentional, then the administrator of the Account Wallet will be able to raise the limit or approve a one-time injection of funds. If the spend was unintentional, then the spending policies for adding funds to virtual wallets did their job by imposing caps.

We are working to make it as easy as possible to fund and use these wallets. We will start with simple ways to onramp and offramp funds within supported geographies, with self-funding via stablecoins available as an alternative for eligible users. The Internet will not shift completely overnight, but with a majority of traffic on the web now being driven by bots, we are excited to give agents and merchants first-class tools for agentic commerce.

Beyond payments alone

Allowing humans to delegate authority to agents to easily buy and sell services is a helpful starting point. But this delegation is not always obvious to the merchants as they interact with agents. Today, if an agent comes to your website, you may know little about them as a user, despite the fact that the agent is acting on behalf of an individual or an organization. This lack of attribution challenges many traditional web business models. It’s easy to give a one-week free trial or sign-up credits to a human or an organization. It’s hard to give these same perks to an agent that lacks a stable identity and when one human can spin up dozens of agents under their control.

We solve this problem by linking wallets to a Cloudflare account via cloudflare.pay. cloudflare.pay will allow agents to optionally identify themselves, since their identity is a delegate of the account. A research agent could live at research.example.cloudflare.pay, allowing merchants to know that it is an agent from a particular organization. This approach will permit agents to maintain consistent and persistent identities, making the experience better for all parties. It will be completely optional for agents to choose to declare their identity or not, and it will be up to businesses to decide whether they want to prioritize transacting with known agents.

Agent identifiers should be human-readable

We believe that the approach to dealing with agents will look like the approach to dealing with VPNs: If someone is unidentified, they are not inherently untrustworthy, but they need to prove themselves more. This is why we have Turnstile and other initiatives to detect bots within Bot Management. Our identity primitive will build on top of this prior work. For example, Web Bot Auth already allows agents to register their identity via a keypair. IDs attached to Cloudflare Wallets allow this keypair to become human-readable.

We know that agentic identity standards are changing quickly, which is why we wanted to keep our approach simple. We are proposing a human-readable identifier for a not-very-readable keypair, similar to the URL and IP-address pairings used in DNS. We are not trying to define a particular schema or other verification system. We only want to make identity simple to remember and easy to declare. As schemas to enrich agentic identity develop through the x402 Foundation’s initiatives, we will seek to adopt them and intend to encourage others to do the same.

The future of agentic commerce

At Cloudflare, we want to offer all the building blocks for agentic commerce to succeed. Monetization Gateway will offer a way for sellers to get paid without setting up traditional payment infrastructure. Wallets will offer a way for buyers to pay headlessly via agents. Identity will allow merchants to communicate with buyers who identify themselves or enforce identification requirements.

All of these building blocks will create a headless marketplace for the Internet. If you are excited about this and want to participate, you can claim your handle now. We’re excited to see what you build and monetize.

sentences.zh: 只需配置一个具有适当余额的帐户钱包，并根据该规则为每个员工创建虚拟钱包即可。

sentences.en: Anyone who exceeds the limits on their Virtual Wallet will be able to request a manual override from a human who is authorized to make changes to the Account Wallet.
sentences.zh: 任何超出虚拟钱包限制的人都可以向有权更改帐户钱包的人员请求手动覆盖。

blocks.html_en: We want to make it easy for Account Wallets to set flexible yet firm spending policies that do not require daily, active monitoring. When something anomalous happens, such as unexpectedly fast spending, a human will be able to review and confirm whether everything is operating as intended. If the spend was intentional, then the administrator of the Account Wallet will be able to raise the limit or approve a one-time injection of funds. If the spend was unintentional, then the spending policies for adding funds to virtual wallets did their job by imposing caps.

sentences.en: We want to make it easy for Account Wallets to set flexible yet firm spending policies that do not require daily, active monitoring.
sentences.zh: 我们希望让账户钱包能够轻松地制定灵活而坚定的支出政策，而不需要每天进行主动监控。

sentences.en: When something anomalous happens, such as unexpectedly fast spending, a human will be able to review and confirm whether everything is operating as intended.
sentences.zh: 当发生异常情况时，例如意外快速支出，人们将能够检查并确认一切是否按预期运行。

sentences.en: If the spend was intentional, then the administrator of the Account Wallet will be able to raise the limit or approve a one-time injection of funds.
sentences.zh: 如果支出是故意的，那么账户钱包的管理员将能够提高限额或批准一次性注入资金。

sentences.en: If the spend was unintentional, then the spending policies for adding funds to virtual wallets did their job by imposing caps.
sentences.zh: 如果支出是无意的，那么向虚拟钱包添加资金的支出政策就会通过施加上限来发挥作用。

blocks.html_en: We are working to make it as easy as possible to fund and use these wallets. We will start with simple ways to onramp and offramp funds within supported geographies, with self-funding via stablecoins available as an alternative for eligible users. The Internet will not shift completely overnight, but with a majority of traffic on the web now being driven by bots, we are excited to give agents and merchants first-class tools for agentic commerce.

sentences.en: We are working to make it as easy as possible to fund and use these wallets.
sentences.zh: 我们正在努力让这些钱包的融资和使用变得尽可能简单。

sentences.en: We will start with simple ways to onramp and offramp funds within supported geographies, with self-funding via stablecoins available as an alternative for eligible users.
sentences.zh: 我们将从简单的方法开始，在受支持的地区内筹集和流出资金，并通过稳定币自筹资金，作为符合条件的用户的替代方案。

sentences.en: The Internet will not shift completely overnight, but with a majority of traffic on the web now being driven by bots, we are excited to give agents and merchants first-class tools for agentic commerce.
sentences.zh: 互联网不会在一夜之间完全转变，但由于现在网络上的大部分流量都是由机器人驱动的，我们很高兴为代理商和商家提供一流的代理商务工具。

blocks.html_en: Beyond payments alone

sentences.en: Beyond payments alone
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是付款

blocks.html_en: Allowing humans to delegate authority to agents to easily buy and sell services is a helpful starting point. But this delegation is not always obvious to the merchants as they interact with agents. Today, if an agent comes to your website, you may know little about them as a user, despite the fact that the agent is acting on behalf of an individual or an organization. This lack of attribution challenges many traditional web business models. It’s easy to give a one-week free trial or sign-up credits to a human or an organization. It’s hard to give these same perks to an agent that lacks a stable identity and when one human can spin up dozens of agents under their control.

sentences.en: Allowing humans to delegate authority to agents to easily buy and sell services is a helpful starting point.
sentences.zh: 允许人类将权力委托给代理以轻松购买和销售服务是一个有用的起点。

sentences.en: But this delegation is not always obvious to the merchants as they interact with agents.
sentences.zh: 但当商家与代理商互动时，这种授权并不总是显而易见的。

sentences.en: Today, if an agent comes to your website, you may know little about them as a user, despite the fact that the agent is acting on behalf of an individual or an organization.
sentences.zh: 如今，如果代理访问您的网站，您作为用户可能对他们知之甚少，尽管该代理代表个人或组织行事。

sentences.en: This lack of attribution challenges many traditional web business models.
sentences.zh: 这种归因的缺乏对许多传统的网络商业模式提出了挑战。

sentences.en: It’s easy to give a one-week free trial or sign-up credits to a human or an organization.
sentences.zh: 向个人或组织提供为期一周的免费试用或注册积分很容易。

sentences.en: It’s hard to give these same perks to an agent that lacks a stable identity and when one human can spin up dozens of agents under their control.
sentences.zh: 当一个人可以在自己的控制下启动数十个特工时，很难向缺乏稳定身份的特工提供同样的福利。

blocks.html_en: We solve this problem by linking wallets to a Cloudflare account via cloudflare.pay. cloudflare.pay will allow agents to optionally identify themselves, since their identity is a delegate of the account. A research agent could live at research.example.cloudflare.pay, allowing merchants to know that it is an agent from a particular organization. This approach will permit agents to maintain consistent and persistent identities, making the experience better for all parties. It will be completely optional for agents to choose to declare their identity or not, and it will be up to businesses to decide whether they want to prioritize transacting with known agents.

sentences.en: We solve this problem by linking wallets to a Cloudflare account via cloudflare.pay.
sentences.zh: 我们通过 cloudflare.pay 将钱包链接到 Cloudflare 帐户来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: cloudflare.pay will allow agents to optionally identify themselves, since their identity is a delegate of the account.
sentences.zh: cloudflare.pay 将允许代理选择性地识别自己的身份，因为他们的身份是帐户的代表。

sentences.en: A research agent could live at research.example.cloudflare.pay, allowing merchants to know that it is an agent from a particular organization.
sentences.zh: 研究代理可以位于 Research.example.cloudflare.pay，让商家知道它是来自特定组织的代理。

sentences.en: This approach will permit agents to maintain consistent and persistent identities, making the experience better for all parties.
sentences.zh: 这种方法将允许代理保持一致和持久的身份，从而为各方提供更好的体验。

sentences.en: It will be completely optional for agents to choose to declare their identity or not, and it will be up to businesses to decide whether they want to prioritize transacting with known agents.
sentences.zh: 代理商完全可以选择是否声明自己的身份，企业可以决定是否优先与已知代理商进行交易。

blocks.html_en: Agent identifiers should be human-readable

sentences.en: Agent identifiers should be human-readable
sentences.zh: 代理标识符应该是人类可读的

blocks.html_en: We believe that the approach to dealing with agents will look like the approach to dealing with VPNs: If someone is unidentified, they are not inherently untrustworthy, but they need to prove themselves more. This is why we have Turnstile and other initiatives to detect bots within Bot Management. Our identity primitive will build on top of this prior work. For example, Web Bot Auth already allows agents to register their identity via a keypair. IDs attached to Cloudflare Wallets allow this keypair to become human-readable.

sentences.en: We believe that the approach to dealing with agents will look like the approach to dealing with VPNs: If someone is unidentified, they are not inherently untrustworthy, but they need to prove themselves more.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，处理代理的方法将类似于处理VPN的方法：如果某人身份不明，他们并不是天生不值得信任，但他们需要更多地证明自己。

sentences.en: This is why we have Turnstile and other initiatives to detect bots within Bot Management.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们在机器人管理中采用 Turnstile 和其他举措来检测机器人。

sentences.en: Our identity primitive will build on top of this prior work.
sentences.zh: 我们的身份原语将建立在之前的工作之上。

sentences.en: For example, Web Bot Auth already allows agents to register their identity via a keypair.
sentences.zh: 例如，Web Bot Auth 已经允许代理通过密钥对注册其身份。

sentences.en: IDs attached to Cloudflare Wallets allow this keypair to become human-readable.
sentences.zh: 附加到 Cloudflare 钱包的 ID 允许该密钥对变得可读。

blocks.html_en: We know that agentic identity standards are changing quickly, which is why we wanted to keep our approach simple. We are proposing a human-readable identifier for a not-very-readable keypair, similar to the URL and IP-address pairings used in DNS. We are not trying to define a particular schema or other verification system. We only want to make identity simple to remember and easy to declare. As schemas to enrich agentic identity develop through the x402 Foundation’s initiatives, we will seek to adopt them and intend to encourage others to do the same.

sentences.en: We know that agentic identity standards are changing quickly, which is why we wanted to keep our approach simple.
sentences.zh: 我们知道代理身份标准正在迅速变化，这就是为什么我们希望保持我们的方法简单。

sentences.en: We are proposing a human-readable identifier for a not-very-readable keypair, similar to the URL and IP-address pairings used in DNS.
sentences.zh: 我们为不太可读的密钥对提出了一个人类可读的标识符，类似于 DNS 中使用的 URL 和 IP 地址对。

sentences.en: We are not trying to define a particular schema or other verification system.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是试图定义特定的模式或其他验证系统。

sentences.en: We only want to make identity simple to remember and easy to declare.
sentences.zh: 我们只想让身份易于记忆且易于声明。

sentences.en: As schemas to enrich agentic identity develop through the x402 Foundation’s initiatives, we will seek to adopt them and intend to encourage others to do the same.
sentences.zh: 随着通过 x402 基金会的举措开发丰富代理身份的模式，我们将寻求采用它们并打算鼓励其他人也这样做。

Monetization Gateway will offer a way for sellers to get paid without setting up traditional payment infrastructure. Wallets will offer a way for buyers to pay headlessly via agents. content_html_zh:
如今，人工智能代理很难尝试新的 API。 他们通常必须浏览为人类而不是代理设计的登录页面，联系人类添加支付方式，生成 API 密钥，然后弄清楚如何调用 API。

对于代理商来说，此流程非常困难，原因有两个：代理商没有稳定的标识符来注册 API，并且他们没有支付 API 的原生方式。 由于缺乏这些东西，他们常常很难使用软件，这限制了代理商务的发展。 人工智能代理通常会完全放弃这些任务，将注册、支付方式和 API 密钥生成交还给人类。 这使得代理尝试和比较许多 API 变得非常困难。

为了解决这个问题，我们创建了 Cloudflare 钱包。 从今天开始，您可以为您的帐户申请一个 Cloudflare Wallet 句柄，这将提供一个唯一的用户名，以帮助您更好地与商家建立联系。 很快，您将能够设置并使用 Cloudflare 钱包来支付 API 和内容费用。

本月早些时候，我们宣布推出货币化网关，以帮助 Cloudflare 客户为其网站和应用程序获得报酬。 Monetization Gateway 将支持使用 x402 协议的小额支付，该协议允许将付款附加到 HTTP 请求。 这些小额支付将能够支付从人工智能推理到数据再到内容的各种用途。 如果您想为货币化网关和其他 x402 兼容端点背后的服务付费或获得报酬，您将需要一个钱包。

Cloudflare 钱包将允许您存储稳定币、购买服务以及通过网络接收资金。 每个拥有钱包的账户还可以为其代理创建虚拟钱包，使他们能够购买 API、MCP 工具、内容等。 您将能够为您的虚拟钱包定义护栏（例如津贴、允许列表和最大交易规模），以帮助您的代理安全地从您的帐户中花钱。 这将允许您的代理以低摩擦和可控风险尝试许多 API。 钱包用户可以选择共享他们的 Cloudflare 钱包句柄，这将使他们在与商家互动时获得稳定的身份。

构建双边代理市场

Cloudflare 的货币化网关将允许符合条件的 Cloudflare 客户将其资源（例如内容或 API）无头地出售给代理买家。 但要使该市场真正发展，代理商需要更多工具以机器原生方式从商家处购买。 Wallets 将为 Cloudflare 的 Agents SDK 添加另一个工具，使 AI 代理能够使用小额支付轻松购买必要的 API 和内容。

Cloudflare 钱包有两种类型：账户钱包和虚拟钱包。

帐户钱包专为 Cloudflare 帐户的所有者和用户而设计。 他们将能够添加资金、将支出委托给代理管理的虚拟钱包，以及根据需要删除资金。

相比之下，虚拟钱包是为代理设计的，并通过 API 密钥进行操作。 在虚拟钱包中，代理将能够根据其权限使用资金。 其最大支出将受到帐户钱包所有者设置的限额的限制。 该框架使代理可以自由地代表用户行事，而无需持续的手动批准，同时限制代理超支的能力。

探索的自由

虚拟钱包令人兴奋，因为它们将允许代理做他们最擅长的事情：探索数十或数百种服务，并找到最适合特定用例的服务。 通过 x402 的稳定币小额支付将使无需帐户的 API 尝试变得简单，从而使代理能够轻松测试新选项。 虚拟钱包的支出上限旨在让人类可以让代理在安全支出限制内自主探索。 这些限制看起来像是约束，但与直觉相反，它们给了代理更多的自由。 如果代理负责 10 美元，那么您可以比代理负责 1,000 美元更不用担心其支出。 如果尝试一个 API 只需花费几美分，那么 10 美元就足以追求和评估许多选项。

一旦您或您的代理选择了要使用的 API，您在帐户钱包中设置的策略将充当虚拟钱包的成本控制。 想要为每位员工提供每周 100 美元的 AI 推理预算吗？ 只需配置一个具有适当余额的帐户钱包，并根据该规则为每个员工创建虚拟钱包即可。 任何超出虚拟钱包限制的人都可以向有权更改帐户钱包的人员请求手动覆盖。

我们希望让账户钱包能够轻松地制定灵活而坚定的支出政策，而不需要每天进行主动监控。 当发生异常情况时，例如意外快速支出，人们将能够检查并确认一切是否按预期运行。 如果支出是故意的，那么账户钱包的管理员将能够提高限额或批准一次性注入资金。 如果支出是无意的，那么向虚拟钱包添加资金的支出政策就会通过施加上限来发挥作用。

我们正在努力让这些钱包的融资和使用变得尽可能简单。 我们将从简单的方法开始，在受支持的地区内筹集和流出资金，并通过稳定币自筹资金，作为符合条件的用户的替代方案。 互联网不会在一夜之间完全转变，但由于现在网络上的大部分流量都是由机器人驱动的，我们很高兴为代理商和商家提供一流的代理商务工具。

不仅仅是付款

允许人类将权力委托给代理以轻松购买和销售服务是一个有用的起点。 但当商家与代理商互动时，这种授权并不总是显而易见的。 如今，如果代理访问您的网站，您作为用户可能对他们知之甚少，尽管该代理代表个人或组织行事。 这种归因的缺乏对许多传统的网络商业模式提出了挑战。 向个人或组织提供为期一周的免费试用或注册积分很容易。 当一个人可以在自己的控制下启动数十个特工时，很难向缺乏稳定身份的特工提供同样的福利。

我们通过 cloudflare.pay 将钱包链接到 Cloudflare 帐户来解决这个问题。 cloudflare.pay 将允许代理选择性地识别自己的身份，因为他们的身份是帐户的代表。 研究代理可以位于 Research.example.cloudflare.pay，让商家知道它是来自特定组织的代理。 这种方法将允许代理保持一致和持久的身份，从而为各方提供更好的体验。 代理商完全可以选择是否声明自己的身份，企业可以决定是否优先与已知代理商进行交易。

代理标识符应该是人类可读的

我们认为，处理代理的方法将类似于处理VPN的方法：如果某人身份不明，他们并不是天生不值得信任，但他们需要更多地证明自己。 这就是为什么我们在机器人管理中采用 Turnstile 和其他举措来检测机器人。 我们的身份原语将建立在之前的工作之上。 例如，Web Bot Auth 已经允许代理通过密钥对注册其身份。 附加到 Cloudflare 钱包的 ID 允许该密钥对变得可读。

我们知道代理身份标准正在迅速变化，这就是为什么我们希望保持我们的方法简单。 我们为不太可读的密钥对提出了一个人类可读的标识符，类似于 DNS 中使用的 URL 和 IP 地址对。 我们并不是试图定义特定的模式或其他验证系统。 我们只想让身份易于记忆且易于声明。 随着通过 x402 基金会的举措开发丰富代理身份的模式，我们将寻求采用它们并打算鼓励其他人也这样做。

代理商务的未来

在 Cloudflare，我们希望提供代理商务成功的所有构建模块。 Monetization Gateway 将为卖家提供一种无需建立传统支付基础设施即可获得付款的方式。 钱包将为买家提供一种通过代理进行无头支付的方式。 身份将允许商家与表明自己身份或强制执行身份要求的买家进行沟通。

所有这些构建模块都将为互联网创建一个无头市场。 如果您对此感到兴奋并想参与其中，您现在就可以领取您的账号。 我们很高兴看到您所构建的内容和货币化内容。
